title: Validity DateTime Range
description: Defines a period of validity with start and end date/time

fromDateTime.description: Date and time at which the range starts, as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6, in UTC (for example, 2025-09-01T09:00:00Z).

toDateTime.description: Date and time at which the range ends, as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6, in UTC (for example, 2025-09-30T17:00:00Z).
